segments.caption: A man is driving a white car along a tree-lined road, with the camera capturing the journey from both an interior view of the driver and an exterior perspective showing the car moving through a park-like setting.

A white car is driving along a tree-lined road, and the camera then focuses on one of its wheels, setting the stage for a tutorial on how to use a tyre repair kit, as indicated by the 'Which?' logo and title card.

A close-up shot shows a white car's wheel, then transitions to the interior where a finger presses the power button to start the engine. The dashboard illuminates, displaying safety indicators like the passenger airbag and seatbelt reminders, signaling the car is now ready for driving.

A presenter examines a white car, first showing its dashboard with illuminated warning lights, then moving to the exterior to inspect the wheel, indicating a detailed vehicle review or diagnostic segment.

A man inspects his white Toyota, starting by checking the tire, then moving to the rear to adjust the license plate, and finally opening the trunk to look inside, all while crouching or bending over in a residential driveway scattered with fallen leaves.
A man retrieves a portable air compressor and sealant from his car’s trunk, preparing to fix a flat tire, as shown by the close-up of the deflated wheel on the curb.
A man is shown fixing a flat tire on his white car by applying sealant from a bottle into the valve stem, indicating he is using a tire sealant kit to temporarily repair the puncture.

A man crouches beside a white car on a leaf-strewn sidewalk, using a portable compressor to inflate a tire. He is focused on the task, connecting the hose to the valve stem and monitoring the process as he speaks, indicating he is demonstrating or explaining how to properly maintain tire pressure.

A man is shown charging his electric car, first connecting the charging cable to the vehicle's charging port, then plugging the other end into a 12V socket inside the car, likely to power a device or to demonstrate an alternative charging method.
A person plugs a device into a car’s 12V socket to power a portable tire inflator, which they then use to inflate a flat tire on the ground, indicating a roadside repair.
A close-up, low-angle shot captures a light-colored car's wheel slowly rolling forward over a cobblestone sidewalk scattered with fallen autumn leaves, with the camera following the tire's movement.
A car is shown in motion, its wheels rolling over a cobblestone curb scattered with fallen autumn leaves, before driving away down a residential street lined with buildings and trees.
A man drives a white car along a tree-lined, leaf-strewn road, speaking as he navigates the scenic route.
A man drives a white car along a tree-lined, leaf-strewn road, speaking to the camera as he navigates the scenic, park-like route.

A driver is seen on a tree-lined road, then the video transitions to a promotional segment from "Which?" advertising a one-month trial for £1, highlighting sections on best buy tyres, saving money on tyres, and recommended breakdown companies.

A static promotional graphic from Which? advertises a one-month trial for just £1, featuring three key service categories: "Best Buy tyres," "How to save money on tyres," and "Recommended breakdown companies."
